briefing: - 立即处置CVE-2026-129354：网络设备栈溢出，优先隔离暴露面。
- 次优先CVE-2026-129433：命令注入RCE 9.9，排查对外接口。
- 未见在野利用及勒索软件关联，但高危漏洞仍需按暴露面优先处置。
- 本次批量披露6个漏洞，高危集中在网络设备与ERP/业务系统，呈集中公告趋势。

items.title: Dokploy服务名命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 已认证组织成员可通过 serviceName 参数注入系统命令，获取服务器权限
items.action_zh: 升级到 0.31.1 或以上；限制组织成员权限
items.repro_note: 认证组织成员调用相关功能，构造 serviceName 注入命令
items.impact_scope: 部署管理平台，权限较高
items.description: Dokploy before 0.31.1 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in getComposeContainerCommand() that allows authenticated organization members to execute shell commands via the serviceName parameter. Attackers can store serviceName values with shell metacharacters through backup.create or backup.update tRPC procedures, executing commands as root when scheduled backups run and taking over the host via the mounted Docker socket.

items.title: Zr.Admin.NET路径遍历读文件
items.summary_zh: 登录用户经 /common/DownloadFile 的 path 参数读任意文件，可窃取密钥伪造管理员令牌
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级至官方修复版本；临时限制 DownloadFile 路径参数
items.impact_scope: 后台管理系统，可读配置密钥
items.description: Zr.Admin.NET commit 0ee1ab8 through commit eb9228a contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows any logged-in user to read arbitrary server files via the path parameter of /common/DownloadFile. Attackers can supply absolute paths or ../ sequences to read appsettings files and use the JwtSettings SecretKey to forge administrator tokens.

items.title: ERP系统DiyFileUpload任意上传
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可调用 /ws.asmx 的 DiyFileUpload 上传任意文件，可能植入后门控制服务器
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；禁用 DiyFileUpload 或限制 /ws.asmx
items.repro_note: 访问 /ws.asmx 调用 DiyFileUpload，构造上传参数
items.impact_scope: ERP业务系统，可能成后门入口
items.description: A weakness has been identified in Wuxi Wubang Security Software Wubang Five-in-One Safety Production Management Information System up to 3.5. Affected by this vulnerability is the function DiyFileUpload of the file /ws.asmx. This manipulation causes unrestricted upload. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: DIR-600L HNAP处理器栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可向 HNAP 处理逻辑发送恶意请求触发栈溢出，可能导致设备崩溃或远程代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复固件；无法升级则禁用 HNAP 或限制公网访问
items.repro_note: 远程请求 HNAP 处理接口，发送超长字段触发栈溢出
items.impact_scope: 边界家用路由器，常暴露公网
items.description: A flaw has been found in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. Affected by this issue is the function hnap_main of the file htdocs/cgibin of the component HNAP Handler. Executing a manipulation can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: Tenda AC18固件升级校验缺失
items.title_zh: Tenda AC18固件升级校验缺失
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可向 /cgi-bin/upgrade 提交未校验固件，导致设备被刷入恶意固件
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复固件；临时限制 /cgi-bin/upgrade 访问
items.repro_note: 访问 /cgi-bin/upgrade 上传构造固件，校验未生效
items.impact_scope: 家用路由器，可能被持久控制
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in Tenda AC18 15.03.05.05_multi/15.03.05.19 Build 6318. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /cgi-bin/upgrade of the component Firmware Upgrade Handler. Such manipulation of the argument upgradeFile leads to insufficient verification of data authenticity. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: TEW-657BRM路由器栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可发送恶意请求触发栈溢出，可能导致路由器崩溃或执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复固件；无法升级则限制公网管理访问
items.repro_note: 远程向设备服务接口发送超长请求触发栈溢出
items.impact_scope: 老旧家用路由器，边界暴露
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in TRENDnet TEW-657BRM 1.00.1. The exploit is now public and may be used.
